settings.downloadNoHttps: Download Epic games over HTTP (for LanCache)
settings.downloadNoHttpsHelp: Only useful if you run a LanCache server on your network. LanCache cannot cache HTTPS downloads, so this downloads Epic games over plain HTTP and lets other PCs on your network install them from the local cache. Each downloaded chunk is still checked against the game manifest. Leave off otherwise.

wineExplanation.wine-crossover: Wine-Crossover is based on the Crossover OpenSource Wine project and is recommended for DX11 or older games.
wineExplanation.wine-staging-macos: Wine-Staging-macOS is based on the mainline Wine project and is recommended for DX11 or older games, especially when paired with the DXMT tool.
